core_categories: Medical Consumables; Surgical Instruments; Healthcare Equipment; Anaesthesia & Respiratory; Woundcare & Compression; Urology & Continence
specialty_focus: Jackson Allison Medical & Surgical is a New Zealand-based wholesale medical distributor established in 1981. It specializes in sourcing, importing, and distributing single-use medical consumables, surgical instruments, and healthcare equipment to hospitals, laboratories, aged care facilities, and primary health providers. The company focuses on reliable, high-volume clinical supplies and provides clinical support to medical professionals and operating theatres.
